mandate: C318 — test the cross-sectional COVARIANCE / BETA co-movement statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -co-movement, long low/short high): beta (trailing-L OLS slope vs equal-weight market), corr (trailing-L Pearson correlation vs market), coskew (trailing-L co-skewness), cokurt (trailing-L co-kurtosis), dsbeta (trailing-L downside beta). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and beta-vs-correlation-vs-comoment-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signals: beta=trailing-L cov(r_i,r_m)/var(r_m); corr=Pearson(r_i,r_m); coskew=mean(rd_i*rd_m^2)/(std_i*std_m^2); cokurt=mean(rd_i*rd_m^3)/(std_i*std_m^3); dsbeta=cov(min(r_i,0),min(r_m,0))/var(min(r_m,0)); score=-co-movement (long low/short high); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0. r_m = equal-weight cross-sectional mean of r_i.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite returns treated as NaN; never impute; a lookback without enough valid observations yields NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs beta/corr/coskew(comoment) vs placebo (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns, same reference positions); shares = |net| / sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
